entries.responsibility: Loopback authenticated newline JSON worker. It owns one serial ModelUtil/Model executor, request idempotency/job state, reflection-dispatched allowlisted COMSOL calls, bounded walk/probe discovery, and compile/execute of Java source against a selected model.
invariants: Every socket request must present the worker token before dispatch (186-231).
Engine calls are serialized through the single engine executor; health/status bypass it (129-160, 233-282).

Source compilation hashes source and checks the declared class/entrypoint before invocation (400-466, 467-482).

entries.error_side_effect_boundary: connect/model/code execution and reflected calls can mutate server/model state; generic Throwable from an engine task becomes ENGINE_CALL_FAILED with unknown=true (233-282). Discovery swallows selected read failures, while source execution invokes the selected static run method against a mutable model (433-482, 663-726).

findings.finding: executeJava accepts any caller-provided regular .java path and invokes a static run(Model[,Map]) against the mutable model selected only by tag. The worker checks class shape and rejects one static-initializer pattern, but has no trusted source-root/class allowlist or model revision/fingerprint check at this boundary.
findings.impact: A caller that passes an allowed request can run arbitrary source in the worker's classpath and can target a stale/mutated model tag; upstream authorization may narrow this, but the worker implementation does not enforce that trust boundary itself.

findings.finding: walk/probeChildren report bounded discovery but silently skip malformed candidate specs, unknown candidate methods, no-such-method errors, and safeInvokeString read failures.

findings.finding: encode and the minimal JSON writer pass Number values through without a finite-number check.
findings.impact: NaN or infinity returned by an engine call can produce invalid NDJSON and break the protocol consumer instead of a bounded worker error.

findings.finding: handles, requests, and compiledArtifacts are process-lifetime concurrent maps with no eviction; status with an empty request id enumerates all request state.
findings.impact: A long-lived worker can accumulate unbounded remote handles, idempotency records, and compiled-artifact metadata, increasing memory and disclosure exposure.

findings.finding: conversionScore does not score string-to-enum conversion although convert implements enum conversion.
findings.impact: An otherwise valid enum argument can be rejected during overload selection before the conversion branch is reached.

findings.finding: The lock identity canonicalizes the host for lock acquisition but ModelUtil.connect is called with the original host string.
